policy.kanji: All ja_on/ja_kun; hiragana; strip affix hyphens and dotted okurigana; no nanori.
policy.kun: Original kun stem/okurigana pairs retained for contextual compatibility checks.
policy.reproducibility: Cached retrieval timestamps are reused; no generation-time timestamp. Identical verified sources and generator yield byte-identical artifacts.
policy.usage: No rare/obsolete forms or readings are dropped; source usage and sense restrictions are preserved in the restrictions sidecar. XML entity descriptions are expanded by the XML parser.
policy.words: All exact kanji-containing orthographies; obey re_restr/re_nokanji; unique readings ordered by commonness then source order.
